string.name: about_tagline
string.value: Open-source podcast manager for HarmonyOS NEXT

string.name: about_text_source
string.value: Podlune is a podcast client for HarmonyOS NEXT. The lineage is AntennaPod → HomenaPod → Podlune: the original Android podcast app AntennaPod (GNU GPL-3.0) was ported to HarmonyOS as HomenaPod, and Podlune is a derivative of that port — it keeps the data layer and playback core, reworks the UI and interactions, and adds new features. The code is written in ArkTS / ArkUI and does not copy Android source. Like the upstream projects, Podlune is licensed under GNU GPL-3.0, so redistribution must keep the attribution and license notices. Podlune does not use AntennaPod’s name, icon or brand as its own product identity.

string.name: about_text_privacy_local
string.value: Everything you create stays on this device: subscriptions, playback progress, queue, favourites, listening history and downloaded audio. There is no account, no cloud sync, no ads and no analytics - nothing about your listening is uploaded to us or to third parties.

string.name: about_text_privacy_network
string.value: The app goes online only to do what you asked: refresh podcast feeds, download cover art and audio, stream episodes, search podcast directories (Apple Podcasts / fyyd / Podcast Index), and import or export OPML. Requests go to the sites you subscribed to and to the search services above.

string.name: about_text_privacy_permissions
string.value: Declared permissions: network access, network state (Wi-Fi-only auto download), background audio playback, accelerometer (shake to reset the sleep timer while it runs) and vibration (a short alert shortly before the sleep timer ends, off by default). All of them are normal-level permissions granted automatically at install - the app never shows a permission prompt. No location, contacts, camera or photo access is requested.

string.name: about_text_credits
string.value: Podlune is an AI-generated open-source project: its code, resources and documentation were produced by a large language model (DeepSeek, driven by DeepSeek Harness) over iterative natural-language sessions. It bundles no closed-source third-party SDK and no advertising library.

string.name: about_text_disclaimer
string.value: Provided as-is under the GNU GPL-3.0, without warranty of any kind. Podcast audio comes from third-party servers whose availability and quality are outside our control. Episodes, artwork, names and trademarks belong to their respective owners; this app only subscribes to and plays them.

string.name: legal_license_body
string.value: Lineage: AntennaPod → HomenaPod → Podlune. Both the upstream AntennaPod and its HarmonyOS port HomenaPod are GNU GPL-3.0; Podlune is a derivative of HomenaPod and is therefore released under GPL-3.0 as well. Per GPL-3.0, the complete corresponding source is made available when the app is distributed (see the About page; it must be reachable before release). You may obtain, modify and redistribute it, keeping the attribution, upstream notice and the full license text. No closed-source third-party SDK or advertising SDK is bundled.

string.name: legal_data_body
string.value: Subscriptions come from RSS/Atom feeds you add; their content belongs to the respective podcasters. Chinese charts use the public xyzrank.com APIs, Apple charts use Apple public chart data, and search uses public APIs such as iTunes Search. The app only uses this data for discovery; it does not store or redistribute the raw datasets.

string.name: legal_privacy_body
string.value: The app collects and uploads no personal data: no accounts, no analytics SDK, no ads. Subscriptions, playback positions, queue, downloads and bookmarks stay on this device. Network access is used only to fetch feeds, charts and search results, download audio, and call an AI transcript service you configure yourself.

string.name: legal_permission_body
string.value: Network and network state: fetching feeds, charts and audio downloads. Background running: background playback and scheduled refresh. Vibration: sleep-timer reminder. Accelerometer: shake to control playback. All of them can be revoked at any time in system settings.
